Rio Technologies is the full-stack marketing and analytics AI platform built to address the complex digital distribution needs for the top Brands.

Technology

Our proprietary technology platform iPanema™, utilizes best-in-class technologies, including Robotic Process Automation, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning components, analyzing millions of user interactions worldwide to maximize marketing efficiency, deliver measurable impact, and actionable insights.

Marketing

Using multiple RTB platforms, we manage to reduce costs and target the high valued users based on their interest correlation. We operate on all the major platforms and aggregate the data to a single point where we can make data-based decisions at a huge scale.

Consumer First

Our Goal is to provide solutions that help you take small steps to make big decisions.

We make shopping simple, affordable, and hassle-free. When it comes to making your life easier, we make no compromises.
